drivers: Degenerate item: every grid cell contains 0 figures, so all cells render as blank and the fill/rotation rules are invisible
Four of the eight options (A, C, F, H) are visually identical blank cells, making the keyed answer indistinguishable from distractors
Success is essentially guessing; ability only helps in realizing the answer should be a blank cell (narrowing to 4 options, ~0.25)
Confusing presentation may cause some test-takers to pick a triangle option or run out of time deliberating
